terms.periods_note: Clause 2(c): "Each Borrowing Base Certificate for a Collection Period ending on or after 1 June 2026 shall be calculated using the Credit Agreement as amended by this Amendment. No Borrowing Base Certificate for an earlier Collection Period is reopened, and the Collection Period ending 31 May 2026 is calculated without it." Clause 3 adds a condition: "This Amendment takes effect on the later of its effective date and the date on which the Lender has received this Amendment signed by each party and payment of the upsize fee agreed in a separate letter." The document does not say when, or whether, the upsize fee was paid. The 2(a) quote for the Commitment gives the old and new figures. The document does not state the old or new Facility Limit figures; it says only that the limit is "increased accordingly". The document also does not name the term in Schedule 2, row 2.

packs.summary: All expected submissions for the period were received, and our checks have raised queries to the borrower on missing loans and charge-off differences, referred a leverage question for expert review and confirmed a vehicle pledged across two facilities, which has been reported to the lender. The recomputed borrowing base and availability are set out below, and the remaining differences noted were within tolerance and logged without alert.

sections.heading: Submissions
sections.text: We received the monthly loan tape, servicer report and borrowing base certificate. We also received the quarterly financial statements, the quarterly compliance certificate and the latest amendment to the facility documents. No submissions are outstanding.

sections.heading: Reconciliation
sections.text: Our roll-forward of the pool expected a balance of {{expected}}, against {{actual}} on the tape, leaving a gap of {{gap}}. The roll-forward identified {{missing}} loans missing from the tape, and we have queried this with the sender. The servicer report shows charge-offs {{charge_off_difference}} higher than the tape, with {{charge_off_loans}} loans charged off in the report but still live on the tape; this has also been queried with the sender. The tape includes new columns with no corresponding platform field; these have been logged within tolerance and no alert was raised.

sections.heading: Borrowing base and terms
sections.text: We recomputed the borrowing base at {{borrowing_base}}, giving availability of {{availability}}. The borrower's certificate shows a borrowing base {{certificate_difference}} above our recomputed figure, a rounding difference within the agreed certificate tolerance of {{tolerance}}; this has been logged and no alert was raised. The latest amendment raises both the facility limit and the dealer limit with effect from a later period; we have logged the changes within tolerance and raised no alert.

sections.heading: Triggers and covenants
sections.text: The rolling delinquency average was {{delinquency_average}}, against a delinquency trigger of {{delinquency_limit}}. The borrower reported leverage of {{leverage_reported}}, against a maximum of {{leverage_limit}}. The borrower keeps an affiliate guarantee of {{guarantee}} off its balance sheet; if that guarantee is counted, leverage would be {{leverage_with_guarantee}}, above the maximum. Whether the guarantee should count has been sent for expert review, and any conclusion on the covenant rests with the lender.

sections.heading: Collateral
sections.text: We confirmed that a vehicle securing a loan in this facility also secures a loan in the Northmoor facility. The lender has been informed and will decide on the next steps.

sections.heading: Open items
sections.text: There are {{open_items}} items requiring action. The queries to the sender on loans missing from the tape and on the charge-off differences remain open pending a response. The leverage question is with expert review, and the vehicle pledged in both facilities is with the lender for decision.

charge_off_loans.means: loans charged off in the report but live on the tape

certificate_difference.means: certificate borrowing base above the recomputed one

leverage_with_guarantee.means: leverage if the affiliate guarantee counts

guarantee.means: affiliate guarantee kept off the balance sheet

packs.summary: The May loan tape and borrowing base certificate have been received, but the May servicer report is late and has been chased with the servicer. The delinquency average is close to its trigger and one vehicle appears to secure a loan in both Bramble and Northmoor; both matters have been reported to the lender for its decision.

sections.heading: Submissions
sections.text: The May loan tape and the May borrowing base certificate were received. The May servicer report is late and has not yet been received. A reminder was sent to the servicer, followed by an escalation, and the query remains open with them.

sections.heading: Triggers
sections.text: The delinquency average stands at {{delinquency_average}}, against a trigger of {{delinquency_limit}}, above which an amortisation event would occur. The trigger has not been breached, but the average is close to it: a June delinquency figure above {{june_threshold}} would breach it. This has been confirmed and reported to the lender, who will decide what action, if any, to take. The excess spread average for March and April was {{excess_spread}}, against a floor of {{excess_spread_floor}}.

sections.heading: Borrowing base and collections
sections.text: The borrowing base position is pending until the May servicer report arrives. May principal collections fell by {{collections_change}} against April. This is in line with the pattern seen last May, when principal collections fell by {{last_year_change}}. The movement is within tolerance and has been logged; no alert has been raised.

sections.heading: Collateral
sections.text: One vehicle has been identified as securing a loan in both the Bramble and Northmoor portfolios. This has been confirmed and reported to the lender, who will decide how it should be resolved.

sections.heading: Open items
sections.text: There are {{open_items}} matters requiring action. The late May servicer report remains outstanding with the servicer, and the borrowing base cannot be completed until it arrives. The delinquency average close to its trigger and the vehicle securing loans in both Bramble and Northmoor have been reported to the lender and await its decision.

open_items.means: findings that need someone to act

delinquency_limit.means: delinquency trigger: an amortisation event above it

june_threshold.means: June delinquency above which the trigger is breached

excess_spread.means: excess spread average, March and April

collections_change.means: fall in May principal collections against April

last_year_change.means: fall in principal collections last May

packs.summary: All three quarterly submissions due were received, and both concentration tests pass. Loan-to-value counting a post-quarter markdown has been sent for expert review, and a query has been raised with the sender about one investment's valuation that is older than the agreement allows.

sections.heading: Submissions
sections.text: The quarterly NAV report, valuation report and compliance certificate were all received.

sections.heading: Loan-to-value
sections.text: Loan-to-value on reported NAV is {{ltv_reported}}, against a maximum loan-to-value of {{ltv_limit}}. Counting the post-quarter markdown of {{markdown}}, loan-to-value is {{ltv_with_markdown}}. The loan-to-value position with and without the markdown has been sent for expert review, and no conclusion is drawn here pending that review. Any decision on the outcome rests with the lender.

sections.heading: Valuations and concentration
sections.text: One investment's valuation is {{stale_days}} days old, which is older than the valuation age limit of {{valuation_limit}} days that the agreement allows. A query has been raised with the sender. The largest investment represents {{largest_position}} of NAV and the five largest investments together represent {{top_five}} of NAV. Both concentration tests pass.

sections.heading: Open items
sections.text: There are {{open_items}} items that need someone to act: the expert review of loan-to-value with and without the post-quarter markdown, and the query to the sender on the investment valuation that is older than the agreement allows.
